gloss: to measure (time); to plan; to scheme

definitions.explanation: To measure time, duration, or numerical intervals — typically using a clock, stopwatch, or counter.

definitions.gloss: to plan; to plot; to scheme
definitions.explanation: To devise or attempt something, often with a calculated or strategic intent. In set phrases this sense can carry either neutral or negative connotations.

notes:
Kanji variant of はかる. Use {計|はか}る for measuring time or intervals, or in set phrases meaning 'to plan / to scheme'. Distinguished from ⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧ (physical measurement of length, depth), ⟦{量|はか}る→量る：28293_hakaru⟧ (weight, volume), and ⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧ (to attempt / plan an undertaking).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{計|はか}る: to time something
- ⟦タイム→タイム：23539_taimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{計|はか}る: to measure a time
- ⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{計|はか}る: to seek a resolution
- ⟦{暗殺|あんさつ}→暗殺：10142_ansatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{計|はか}る: to plot an assassination

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure length, height, depth, speed
- ⟦{量|はか}る→量る：28293_hakaru⟧: to measure weight or volume
- ⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧: to attempt or plan (large undertaking)
